onset.Description: Time of stimulus onset in seconds from the beginning of the run.

duration.Description: Time of stimulus duration in seconds.

stim_type.Description: Indicates whether the stimulus was a sentence or a question.

sentence_id.Description: ID number of the sentence presented, from 1 to 108. NaN for questions.

stimulus_text.Description: Text of the presented stimulus, either a sentence or a question.

response_time.Description: Time taken by the participant to respond to the question in seconds. NaN for sentences.

answer_index.Description: Correct answer index for the question presented, one of A, B, C, or D. NaN for sentences.

question_response.Description: Participant's response to the question, one of a, b, c, or d. NaN for sentences or null responses.
